name: nexuskit
description: 面向 AI 编程 Agent 的个人工程技能体系：规划、实施、排错、审查、知识沉淀的 18 个 nk-* 技能与共享约定

interface.shortDescription: Personal engineering skill system: plan, work, debug, review, compound
interface.longDescription: NexusKit is a toolbox of 18 nk-* skills: nk-ask-ljq, nk-init, nk-ideate, nk-brainstorm, nk-grill, nk-plan, nk-work, nk-commit, nk-handoff, nk-debug, nk-review, nk-simplify, nk-compound, nk-close, nk-wayfinder, nk-to-issue, nk-wizard, nk-wait-what. Choose any entry for your situation. Brainstorm or wayfinder feeds standard planning; work delivers one unit with verification, review and commit; close checks the combined delivery and handles artifacts. Shared conventions cover planning, knowledge, vocabulary and commit cadence.
